contract: Rollback is admitted only after HALT + rollback_required and lifecycle phase rollback_required.
Confirmed mutation scope must be the exact ordered prefix and is inverted in strict reverse order.
Uncertain mutation scope never guesses per-operation inverses; it falls back to restoring the bound pre-state backup.
Rollback plan binds source plan, ordering digest, transaction id, pre-state digest and backup reference.
Plan contains value digests instead of secret-bearing raw values and exposes no transport/apply/rollback/writer capability.
13.9 fresh post-rollback verification remains mandatory before rolled_back completion.
pass_requires: reverse-order inverse plan for confirmed prefix
